description: mods (function hooks, under CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_FUNCTION_HOOKS=1): the to-human view of the transcript, mcp__doperpowers__AskUserQuestion (the built-in's input plus async, which withdraws the built-in), the kairos button in the prompt footer, the agents pane, and the model's own compact / context_usage tools (compaction at the end of the turn that asked, then the resume prompt it wrote). to-human-stream.sh (MessageDisplay) draws the same <message> mark while a message streams; old <to-human>, <essential>, <need-input> and <insight> marks read as aliases of it. kairos: proactive mode — on from launch with KAIROS=1 or mid-session with /kairos, kept across compaction and resume; /kairos off ends it. compact-instructions.md: PreCompact prints it, so every compaction's summary is written as the note a memory-reset self resumes from. smns-record.sh (SessionStart, Stop): a session in a project joins its sminos log at its start, and its <message> marks and async asks reach the log as messages to the host
